symptom: `mxcli docker check` reports 0 errors and exits 0, then `mxcli run --local` refuses to start with CE0463 "The definition of this widget has changed" at the same widgets; `docker check --no-update-widgets` reports them. A gate that says yes about a model it did not examine
cause: `Check` ran `mx update-widgets` on its temporary copy before `mx check` by default, to suppress "false CE0463" — so it validated a widget-normalised model, never the stored one. The CE0463s it cleared were real: MxBuild and `run --local` build the project as stored. An earlier fix only added a closing note saying so; the verdict and exit status stayed the normalised copy's
insight: Disclosing a normalisation in the output does not fix a gate: callers read the exit status, not the note. The fix moves diagnose-ce0463's second control into the gate: check the stored project (its verdict and exit status), and only when that found CE0463 run update-widgets on the same copy and re-check, labelling each "stale widget definition — `mxcli fix widgets` fixes it" or "persists after update-widgets" — no second check on a clean project. mx check's text output does not name the page and a blank 11.13 app has four `dataGrid2_1` and four `dataGrid21` on different pages, so the lines are compared as counts (`(4×)`, `(2 of 3)`); `-j` would give module/document, but 9.24's mx rejects it ("Option 'j' is unknown") before checking anything. A stale instance needs no second package version: add one property to the widget XML inside the project's own .mpk (Data grid 2 3.4.0 + a boolean → 11 CE0463 on a blank 11.13.0 app, all cleared by update-widgets). Measured: old default 0 errors / exit 0; new default 11 errors / exit 1, all 11 labelled stale; `--update-widgets` 0 / exit 0 (old behaviour kept as opt-in); after `mxcli fix widgets` (11 units, MPR v2 kept) the default reports 0. The project tree's hash was unchanged by every run. Tests that pinned update-widgets-before-check as the default now pass `UpdateWidgetsFirst`
